---
agent: developer-agent
description: Developer Agent creates development plan and GitHub Issues grouped under Epics, then assigns to GitHub Copilot Coding Agent. Note, this prompt is suited for execution within VS Code, to trigger GitHub Copilot Coding Agent via GitHub Issues. 
---

Create a comprehensive development plan for the Java text adventure game based on the specifications in `/specs/docs/` folder. Next you can create GitHub issues for all tasks and attach to an Epic. Assign the GitHub Copilot Coding Agent to this Epic.
